answer: Yesterday's bridge, this morning's opal, and a haven that never happened: read the file and the farm gives itself away. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 619 masks, 111420 POA, gone on one grade. Give the epoch its backbone: Pewter mender lead mark poured at the casting floor, shown by each lead is a year of pewter logs in the pewterer's ledger, judged by strangers who owe the applicant nothing. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
